title: Our DNA
content: ### Winkelmann Foundation Screw. Winkelmann Foundation Screw PL Sp. z o.o. Sp.k, part of the Winkelmann Group and located in Legnica, Poland, specializes in the production of screw foundation piles using the patented **“flowforming”** technology. Winkelmann Foundation Screw PL delivers screw foundation piles that **significantly reduce project completion times**, are very easy to dismantle, and—most importantly—environmentally friendly. ## Location of Winkelmann Foundation Screw PL Sp. z o.o. Sp.k. facility in Legnica. Today, the Winkelmann Group is one of the world’s leading organizations offering industrial solutions in high-performance and energy-efficient components and systems. The history of the family-owned Winkelmann Group dates back to 1898, when Heinrich Winkelmann and Caspar Pannhoff founded Winkelmann + Pannhoff GmbH in Ahlen. At the core of every phase of our Group’s expansion remain production efficiency, investment in research and development, and the pursuit of technical excellence. These values—rooted in our organizational culture—allow the Winkelmann Group to continuously set new standards in the industry and build long-term relationships with customers worldwide.

title: 50 Years Reflex Winkelmann
content: We have been focusing on the future for over 50 years with our Reflex brand. The foundation of our company is based on solution orientation and pragmatism: In 1898, Heinrich Winkelmann and Caspar Pannhoff founded a workshop for the production of kitchen and household appliances made of enamelled metal in Ahlen, Germany. In the 1950s, along with the industrial boom of the post-war era, the needs of the population for more comfort, such as hot water and central heating, also increased. When the Reflex brand was established in 1972, our vessels quickly developed into prestige products under their own brand. We have always been driven to find ever better solutions to our customers’ challenges. * Our solutions for pressure maintenance are used in a wide range of industries worldwide - from simple vessels to compressor- and pump-controlled pressurisation stations. When transitioning from the industrial age to the digital one, we took advantage of the new possibilities of digitalization early on, to improve the lives of our customers.

title: History of the company - WINKELMANN OEM Competence
content: 3. History of the company. ## History of Winkelmann Building+Industry. Heinrich Winkelmann and Caspar Pannhoff found a workshop to produce kitchen and household appliances made from enamelled metal such as kettles, coffee pots, soap basins, dustpans and milk cans in Ahlen in Westphalia. During the industrial boom during the post-war period, the range changes from enamelled kitchen and household appliances to forming steel plates. Special parts for engineering, the automotive industry as well as heating and water technology, were produced. Founding of Reflex Winkelmann + Pannhoff GmbH + Co. KG. Acquisition of Otto Heat Heizungs-, Energie- und Anlagentechnik GmbH + Co. KG. Heinrich Winkelmann takes over as the fourth generation of manager of the Winkelmann Group at the headquarters in Ahlen. The Reflex training centre is opened in Ahlen. Acquisition of the company Sinusverteiler GmbH. Launch of the Winkelmann production system to optimise and increase efficiency in production processes. The business division is rebranded to Winkelmann Building+Industry and enables the strategic opening of future ranges.
